name: usage-band
description: One tidy bar above the prompt: context against your auto-compact window, 5-hour and 7-day limits against the clock, prompt cache time left, session cost and running agents, each with a hover card.

queueScript.title: Job queue script
queueScript.description: Optional. Path to a job queue script whose `status` command lists its slots, waiting jobs, memory and load (see the README). Set, a row above the band shows them and opens a side pane. Empty hides the row.
